promise_vs_delivery.area: Full-Year Constant Currency (CC) Revenue Growth Guidance
promise_vs_delivery.management_promise: Guided for 3.0% - 4.0% YoY CC revenue growth for the full financial year.
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Revised upward and delivered 4.8% YoY CC revenue growth, beating the initial guidance band on the back of accelerated large deal ramp-ups.
promise_vs_delivery.stocker_analysis: Faster-than-expected client transition to cost-takeout mega programs and strong momentum in European manufacturing clients drove the guidance beat.

promise_vs_delivery.management_promise: Maintain operating margin within the 20.0% - 22.0% target band supported by Project Maximus cost optimization.
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Delivered. Full year operating margin came in at 21.2%, squarely within the guided target band despite rolling wage revisions.
promise_vs_delivery.stocker_analysis: Project Maximus generated ~120 bps in structural cost efficiencies across pyramid optimization, automation, and lean travel, offsetting wage hike drag.

promise_vs_delivery.area: Annual Large Deal Total Contract Value ($10B+ Target)
promise_vs_delivery.management_promise: Target $10 Billion+ in annual large deal TCV with a focus on net new contract generation exceeding 50%.
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Delivered. Recorded an all-time record $17.7 Billion in large deal TCV for FY26 with 54% net new contract share.
promise_vs_delivery.stocker_analysis: Won multiple multi-year cost optimization and vendor consolidation mega-deals in European telecom and automotive sectors.

promise_vs_delivery.management_promise: Integrate German automotive engineering R&D specialist In-tech to scale software-defined vehicle and infotainment engineering.
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Delivered. In-tech integration completed; ER&D revenue contribution grew to 12% of the manufacturing vertical, enabling Tier-1 German OEM wins.
promise_vs_delivery.stocker_analysis: Smooth post-merger integration retained key client relationships across German automotive majors.

demand_momentum.summary: Constant currency pricing realization remained firm. Revenue productivity per employee increased 3.8% YoY driven by automation.

company_specific_metrics.value: Large deal TCV was $3.8 Billion in Q1 FY27 (52% net new). Full-year FY26 large deal TCV stood at an all-time record of $17.7 Billion.
Active client base stands at 1,867. $100M+ annual revenue clients increased to 40 (up from 36 in the prior period). Total employee headcount stabilized at 317,000.
Constant currency pricing realization remained firm. Revenue productivity per employee increased 3.8% YoY driven by automation.

segment_trends.trend: Strong Acceleration: +8.1% YoY CC growth powered by smart factory automation and software-defined vehicle engineering.
Strong Growth: +6.8% YoY CC growth driven by renewable energy grid integration and asset management.
Moderate Recovery: +3.1% YoY CC with demand concentrated in risk/fraud AI platforms and cloud core banking.
Muted / Soft: -0.9% YoY CC due to cautious discretionary consumer spending in North American retail.

demand_momentum.market_share_and_pricing: Infosys gained market share in European digital transformation deals, outperforming tier-1 IT peers in large deal TCV growth.
headwinds_and_risks: Prolonged decision-making cycles on small-ticket discretionary consulting projects.
Regulatory scrutiny around AI deployment governance and regional cross-border data privacy standards.

risks_and_cash.working_capital_and_receivables: Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) stood at 68 days (improved by 2 days YoY). Zero bad debt provisions required.
risks_and_cash.debt_and_capex_burden: Zero long-term borrowings. Cash, cash equivalents, and liquid investments stood at ₹34,200 Cr. Capital allocation policy returned >85% of FCF to shareholders via regular and special dividends.
execution_and_bottlenecks: Higher subcontractor usage in niche cloud AI skill sets creating temporary gross margin drag.
Offshore wage revisions requiring ongoing structural cost optimization under Project Maximus.
risks_and_cash.reported_numbers_comparison: Our financial engine cross-checks that Infosys generated ₹27,610 Cr in Net Profit with ₹28,400 Cr in Operating Cash Flow (103% cash conversion), confirming exceptional balance sheet purity, 0.0x debt, and robust capital return credibility.
